mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing garage into an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing garage into an ADU is a popular and often more affordable option. This typically involves insulating, adding windows and doors, updating electrical and plumbing, and finishing the interior to create a habitable living space. The foundation and structure of the garage must be sound and meet current building codes. A site assessment helps determine feasibility and necessary upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, garage conversions are a popular ADU option, involving insulation, utilities, and interior finishes to create a habitable space, provided the existing structure is sound.
